title: LockSlots[+]
description: A lightweight client-side mod that allows players to lock inventory slots. Locked items cannot be moved, dropped, or modified, helping prevent accidental mistakes while keeping the experience simple and vanilla-friendly.
body:
A lightweight client-side mod that allows players to lock inventory slots.
Locked items cannot be moved, dropped, or modified, helping prevent accidental mistakes while keeping the experience simple and vanilla-friendly.
